text: Aisha, an undocumented Senegalese immigrant in New York City, [takes a job as nanny|trigger|saying yes to an offer] to Rose, the young daughter of a wealthy Upper East Side couple, saving to bring her six-year-old son Lamine over from Senegal. [The Havs are often late to pay her|wrong|exploitation for profit], and the airfare keeps slipping away. She begins to dream of [drowning|images|water and drowning], and waking visions of [the son she left behind|who_suffers|young children] grow stronger in the apartment.
